items.q: That's where I saw the Boogie-Woogie child piano prodigy, Sugar Cane Robinson.

ctx.x: Well, the Million-Dollar came later, when they... That's where I saw the Boogie-Woogie child piano prodigy, Sugar Cane Robinson. Remember him? With Gerald Wilson's orchestra on the bill. Also I first saw Roy Hamilton. Remember him, Roy Hamilton? Fine, fine vocalist. But before...
